verdict.rationale: Ramp's Treasury page states that deposits in a Ramp Checking Account receive FDIC insurance 'up to tens of millions of dollars per depositor' via IntraFi's ICS service. That delivers expanded multi-bank FDIC coverage on operating cash without the finance lead doing anything. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the sweep mechanics (which partner banks, how and when funds are allocated), controls or visibility into the sweep, and independent or hands-on corroboration beyond one marketing line.
